summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new discreet booking system on Candice portfolio. 13/13 pytest cases pass (create/list/status/delete + auth + regression on visits/stats). Frontend booking form renders with all required data-testids, client-side validation works, successful submit shows 'Received, darling.' and hides the form. Backstage REQUESTS tab loads, count updates on Mark handled ('4 new · 4 total' → '3 new · 4 total'), XSS payloads render fully escaped (no dialog fires). Travel dates show 'JUL 04 — 13', 'JUL 13 — 23', 'JUL 24 — 30'. STATS + COUNTRIES tabs still render. Booking inbox cleaned to 0 items at end.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is very large (~1900 lines) — inline booking-form CSS + submit script + all sections. Consider splitting booking submit JS to a small booking.js for maintainability.
GET /api/bookings returns hard-coded to_list(100). If inbox grows past 100 the admin panel silently misses older items — add pagination or higher limit.
No rate limiting on POST /api/bookings — public endpoint is trivially spammable. Consider IP-based throttling or captcha since this exposes an unauthenticated write.
BookingBody has no length limits at Pydantic layer (only sliced server-side). Very long JSON bodies still parse first — consider Pydantic Field(max_length=…) to reject early and avoid needless work.
admin.js loadRequests correctly uses esc() for HTML escaping — verified XSS-safe. Good.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 TEST_ bookings during backend + UI runs; all deleted at end via DELETE /api/bookings/{id}. Inbox verified empty ({items:[], new_count:0}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_bookings.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_bookings.py -v`. Covers bookings CRUD + auth + visits regression. Admin panel is opened via URL#backstage, password field is #adminPassInput, enter button #btnAdminEnter, then click `button.admin-tab[data-tab='requests']`. Wait ~3s for the red veil overlay before interacting.
